newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Merger talk continues to fuel Nordbanken.
newsitem.headline: Merger talk continues to fuel Nordbanken.

text.p: State-controlled Swedish bank Nordbanken rose on Tuesday on continuing rumours of a merger.
At 1150 GMT the share had risen 10 crowns to 275, or nearly four percent, while the bourse's general index had gained 1.03 percent.
"There is no real explanation. It's probably renewed speculation about a merger between Nordbanken and S-E-Banken. But the whole banking sector is quite upbeat today," said one broker.
S-E-Banken and Nordbanken announced three weeks ago that merger talks had failed, with no reason given.
S-E-Banken shares were unchanged at 82.50 crowns at midday Tuesday.
Banking shares have been rising since last autumn on rumours of a sector shake-up.
Since then Handelsbanken has acquired mortgage bank Stadshypotek and last week Swedbank and Foreningsbanken announced a merger.
